name: Main menu
when: When the game opens or the player returns to the title screen.
includes: Continue, New Game, Load Game, Encyclopedia, Settings, branding and version. Desktop also adds Quit.

name: New game modes
when: After selecting New Game.
includes: Campaign, Skirmish, Random Map and access to the map editor.

name: Campaign selection
when: When starting a campaign.
includes: Six pantheon campaigns, story preview, mission list and difficulty.

name: Skirmish map selection
when: When starting a skirmish.
includes: Authored map cards, map artwork, scenario details and selection controls.

name: Pantheon and match setup
when: After choosing a legacy skirmish scenario.
includes: Player and rival pantheons, seat names, controllers and difficulty.

name: Random map setup
when: When starting a generated map.
includes: Map size, terrain and resource settings, victory rules, seats, pantheons and difficulty.

name: Authored map match setup
when: After choosing an authored skirmish map.
includes: Map preview, seat configuration, factions and match options.

name: Settings Gameplay
when: From the main menu or pause menu.
includes: Adventure and battle speed, enemy movement and gameplay preferences.

name: Settings Interface
when: From the main menu or pause menu.
includes: UI display and interaction preferences.

name: Settings Display
when: From the main menu or pause menu.
includes: Rendering quality and display settings.

name: Settings Audio
when: From the main menu or pause menu.
includes: Music, sound and volume controls.

name: Settings Accessibility
when: From the main menu or pause menu.
includes: Motion and accessibility preferences.

name: Settings Controls
when: From the main menu or pause menu.
includes: Keyboard shortcuts and rebinding.

name: Settings Saves
when: From the main menu or pause menu.
includes: Storage information and save management settings.

name: Encyclopedia Bestiary
when: From Encyclopedia and its Bestiary tab.
includes: Creature families and base and upgraded units grouped by pantheon.

name: Encyclopedia Gods
when: From Encyclopedia and its Gods tab.
includes: Patron and minor gods with benefits and requirements.

name: Encyclopedia Heroes
when: From Encyclopedia and its Heroes tab.
includes: Hero portraits, classes and specialties grouped by pantheon.

name: Encyclopedia Towns
when: From Encyclopedia and its Towns tab.
includes: Town buildings and progression grouped by pantheon.

name: Encyclopedia Spells
when: From Encyclopedia and its Spells tab.
includes: Spell artwork, costs and effects.

name: Encyclopedia Skills
when: From Encyclopedia and its Skills tab.
includes: Hero skill ranks and bonuses.

name: Encyclopedia Artifacts
when: From Encyclopedia and its Artifacts tab.
includes: Equipment, artifact effects and set bonuses.

name: Encyclopedia Abilities
when: From Encyclopedia and its Abilities tab.
includes: Creature ability badges and rule descriptions.

name: Creature detail
when: When opening a unit from the encyclopedia or a creature reference.
includes: Creature artwork, combat attributes, abilities and upgrade information.

name: High scores
when: From the end-of-game summary.
includes: Skirmish and campaign record tabs, scores and recorded match details.

name: Mission briefing
when: At the start of a campaign mission or scenario.
includes: Mission introduction, dialogue, objectives and Begin controls.

name: Adventure map
when: During exploration between battles.
includes: Map, resources, hero selection, minimap, movement, town and hero shortcuts and End Day.

name: Hero and equipment
when: From the hero portrait or Hero command on the adventure map.
includes: Hero attributes, equipment silhouette, inventory, skills and army.

name: Town management
when: When entering an owned town.
includes: Town background, constructed buildings and sites, economy, garrison and visiting hero.

name: Recruitment
when: From an owned creature dwelling.
includes: Creature selection, available population, quantity, cost and destination army.

name: Pantheon and gods
when: From the Pantheon command during a match.
includes: Patron god, minor god choices, devotion and divine progression.

name: Journal Objectives
when: From Journal during a campaign.
includes: Primary and optional objectives and progress.

name: Journal Story
when: From Journal during a campaign.
includes: Mission story and dialogue history.

name: Journal Mission help
when: From Journal during a campaign.
includes: Mission-specific hints and rules.

name: Journal Campaign
when: From Journal during a campaign.
includes: Campaign route, progress and mission outcomes.

name: Pause menu
when: When pressing Escape during exploration or battle.
includes: Resume, save, load, settings, journal, restart and return to main menu.

name: Save game
when: From Pause then Save Game.
includes: Manual slots, save naming, metadata and import controls.

name: Load game
when: From the main menu or pause menu.
includes: Manual saves, autosaves, checkpoint slots, metadata and import/load controls.

name: Keyboard shortcuts
when: When pressing F1.
includes: Current keyboard bindings and help for navigation and game actions.

name: Creature stack inspection
when: When inspecting a creature stack.
includes: Creature portrait, stack size, combat statistics and abilities.

name: Hot seat handover
when: At the next human player turn in a hot-seat match.
includes: Player identity and a ready control while the map is hidden.

name: Confirmation dialog
when: Before a destructive or consequential action.
includes: Action title, explanation, cancel and explicit confirmation.

name: Army exchange
when: When exchanging troops with a town or another hero.
includes: Both armies, stack selection and quantity controls.

name: Mission help dialog
when: When opening a mission help topic.
includes: A focused explanation of a mission mechanic.

name: Story dialogue
when: When a campaign story trigger fires.
includes: Speaker portrait, dialogue text, Continue and Skip.

name: Contextual tip
when: When a new game mechanic is first encountered.
includes: A short explanation, dismissal and disable-tips controls.

name: Mission debrief
when: After completing a campaign mission.
includes: Victory dialogue, mission results, summary and next-mission controls.

name: Campaign complete
when: After the final campaign mission.
includes: Campaign conclusion, epilogue, summary and main-menu controls.

name: Mission failed
when: After a campaign defeat.
includes: Defeat message, restart, checkpoint loading and main-menu controls.

name: Match and campaign summary
when: After a finished mission or match, via Summary.
includes: Score, timeline charts, player statistics and high-score access.

name: Developed town
when: When revisiting a town after constructing and upgrading buildings.
includes: Advanced town art, built structures, services and armies.

name: Building action panel
when: When clicking a town building or empty construction site.
includes: Building information, upgrades, costs, prerequisites and service buttons.

name: Marketplace
when: From the corresponding service in an owned developed town.
includes: Resource selection, buy and sell tabs, rates, quantity and trade controls.

name: Heroes lodge
when: From the corresponding service in an owned developed town.
includes: Available hero portraits, classes, specialties, recruitment cost and Hire.

name: Artifact merchant
when: From the corresponding service in an owned developed town.
includes: Weekly artifact stock, effects, prices and purchase controls.

name: Workshop wares
when: From the corresponding service in an owned developed town.
includes: Workshop inventory, item details, pricing and purchase controls.

name: Divine gifts
when: From the temple building action panel.
includes: Available gifts, Favor cost, hero targeting and receive controls.

name: Hero level up
when: When experience creates a pending level-up decision.
includes: Hero portrait, primary attribute gain and skill choices.

name: Skirmish victory
when: When the player wins a skirmish.
includes: Victory artwork, outcome message, summary and main-menu buttons.

name: Skirmish defeat
when: When the player loses a skirmish.
includes: Defeat artwork, outcome message, summary and main-menu buttons.

name: Neutral creature camp
when: When visiting a recruitable neutral camp.
includes: Available creatures, cost, quantity and recruitment.

name: Map event choice
when: When a hero visits a map event.
includes: Event narrative, alternative choices, costs and rewards.

name: Beacon activation
when: When restoring or activating a mission beacon.
includes: Activation requirement, cost and confirmation.

name: Map editor Map
when: From New Game then Map Editor.
includes: Terrain canvas, tool palette, map name, size and map-wide configuration.

name: Map editor Empires
when: From New Game then Map Editor.
includes: Player seats, factions and starting empire properties.

name: New map
when: From the corresponding map editor toolbar action.
includes: Map size selection and create/cancel controls.

name: Generate map
when: From the corresponding map editor toolbar action.
includes: Generation seed, map parameters and generation controls.

name: Open map library
when: From the corresponding map editor toolbar action.
includes: Saved maps, import and load controls.

name: Map editor validation
when: While reviewing whether an edited map is playable.
includes: Validation errors and links to affected sites.

name: Map editor site properties
when: When selecting or placing a map site.
includes: Site identity, ownership, guards and object-specific settings.

name: Play editor map
when: When play-testing a valid edited map.
includes: Player seats, pantheons, controllers and game-start controls.

name: Leave unsaved map
when: When leaving an editor map with unsaved changes.
includes: Discard-changes confirmation and return to editing.

name: Treasure chest
when: When a hero visits this site on a generated or custom map.
includes: Gold or experience choices and reward values.

name: Quest hut
when: When a hero visits this site on a generated or custom map.
includes: Quest requirements, progress, reward and completion controls.

name: Temple offering
when: When a pantheon with an offering rite uses its temple.
includes: Creature offerings, recruitment value, Favor gained and confirmation.

name: Artifact detail and comparison
when: When selecting equipment or a backpack item on the hero screen.
includes: Artifact name, effect, slot, set membership and equip comparison.

name: Army splitting controls
when: When splitting a hero army stack.
includes: Selected stack, split quantity and destination-slot interaction.

name: Hero spellbook
when: When opening the hero spellbook.
includes: Known spells, magic-school filters, mana and spell details.

name: Adventure spell casting
when: From the Spells action on the adventure map.
includes: Castable adventure spells, mana costs and unavailable-spell explanations.

name: New week announcement
when: At the start of a new week.
includes: Week number, event artwork and weekly growth or event effect.

name: Divine miracle announcement
when: When a divine intervention is invoked.
includes: Miracle illustration, name, context and effect summary.

name: Battle deployment and siege
when: At the start of a battle when Tactics allows deployment.
includes: Battlefield, fortifications, initiative order, deployment zone and Start Battle.

name: Battle log
when: When toggling the combat Log button.
includes: Recent battle actions, damage and combat messages.

name: Tactical battle
when: During a live combat turn.
includes: Initiative order, active stack, grid, commands, spells, miracles and retreat options.

name: Battle spell casting
when: From the Spells command during combat.
includes: Known combat spells, mana costs and cast availability.

name: Surrender confirmation
when: When a battle permits a paid surrender.
includes: Gold cost, preserved surviving army and surrender confirmation.

name: Siege defender selection
when: When the defending town and visiting hero have more than seven army stacks.
includes: Defender choices, selection limit, reserves, merge and confirm controls.

name: Pre-battle encounter
when: Before committing to a guarded encounter or attacking an enemy.
includes: Both armies, strength comparison, rewards, attack, quick battle and withdraw.

name: Construction and upgrade proposal
when: When selecting an unbuilt town site or an available upgrade.
includes: Next building, cost, missing prerequisites, effects and construction action.

name: Level up with divine gifts
when: At gift-granting hero levels such as level 10.
includes: Two divine gift choices alongside the primary gain and skill offers.

name: Notification toast
when: After an action succeeds, is rejected, or produces a short notice.
includes: Brief status text above the current screen.

name: Divine interventions
when: From the adventure map Favor command.
includes: Divine interventions, Favor costs, context filters and targeting requirements.

name: Rival turn summary
when: At the start of the player turn after rival actions.
includes: Brief visible enemy activity grouped by empire.

name: Map tile and site inspection
when: When hovering or pinning a map tile.
includes: Terrain, site information, owner, guards and interaction details.

name: Town army split dialog
when: When Shift-dragging part of an army stack to another slot in town.
includes: Source creature, quantity, cancel and split confirmation.

name: Battle miracles book
when: From Favor during combat.
includes: Available miracles, Favor costs and targeting requirements.

name: Retreat confirmation
when: When a hero retreats from battle.
includes: Consequences and explicit confirmation.

name: Battle victory result
when: After winning a battle.
includes: Casualties for both armies, experience, rewards, hero outcome and Continue.

name: Battle defeat result
when: After losing a battle.
includes: Defeat artwork, losses, hero outcome and Continue.
